name: The Amazing Digital Danganronpa
source:
Today's adventure is  Danganronpa!

Get sent to an old computer that simulates the experience of Danganronpa in the comfort of the Digital Circus! Continue living in peace, or take someone's life to escape!  

[From [url=https://fushiyu-ningiyo.itch.io/the-amazing-digital-danganronpa]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天的冒險是——《槍彈辯駁》！

你將被送進一臺老電腦，不出數字馬戲團也能在裡面模擬體驗《槍彈辯駁》！你可以繼續平靜地生活，也可以為了逃脫，取走某個人的性命！

［摘自[url=https://fushiyu-ningiyo.itch.io/the-amazing-digital-danganronpa]itch.io[/url]］
